title: set_room_playlist
description: Command sent from server to plugin (since 1.6.0) to store the controller's playlist state on the Photon room, so the room's next host can carry the playlist on. Host only: a guest acks not_host. Not in a room: acked error 'not in a room'. A state longer than 2048 UTF-8 bytes: acked error 'state too long'. Otherwise the plugin sets the room properties JMTP (the state) and JMTPt (PhotonNetwork.ServerTimestamp) in one SetCustomProperties call and acks ok. Not staleable: only the latest state matters and writing it is cheap. See server-protocol.md, Room playlist and handover

state.description: The controller's playlist state: an opaque string owned by the controller, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. The plugin stores it as it is and never reads it
